chains.purpose: Run one fixture through recompilation and an interpreter, then compare named full-WRAM checkpoints.
Use the same fixture/harness to separate recomp bugs from emulator-specific behavior.
Capture dynamic 65816 execution context, classify code/data and M/X state, then export reassemblable source.
Feed BSNES trace/CDL through cc65's helper into da65 RANGE/ADDRMODE information for bank-by-bank 65816 disassembly.
Seed labels/memory knowledge, generate a structured disassembly/assets project, and reassemble it.
Extract native graphics, render/edit/validate with SuperFamiconv, then return exact SNES bytes to a reassemblable project.
Drive deterministic scenes headlessly, accumulate code/data coverage, then import that evidence into a collaborative disassembly after a validated CDL adapter.
Create/apply a controlled ROM patch, fingerprint the derived ROM, then run the same deterministic differential evidence loop.
Locate/decode period RNC data with CRC validation and feed decoded payloads into structural/course analysis.
Project canonical labels seed bank-local da65 info files; trace/CDL RANGE and M/X state can be layered on without retyping names.
Replay one project-owned fixture through native recompilation, libretro reference cores, and Mesen while preserving the same named full-WRAM comparison surface.
Translate historical SMV input and embedded SRAM once, replay the same neutral stream in reference and native runtimes, and compare normalized gameplay-state evidence.
Drive player-visible states with shared controller fixtures, capture framebuffer plus machine state headlessly, and summarize them into a queryable evidence-labelled UI atlas.
Drive the same backward-compatible P1/P2 frame-mask stream through native Lua, patched snesref/libretro, and Mesen without emulator-specific controller scripts.
Find a PAL cited address, original observed/inferred/data classification, research source records and candidate USA interval without elevating an unverified mapping or running a ROM.
